cards.title: Glossary
items: Intake: the G0 venue; a signed request in, a ready contract out
Controlled register: the closed dictionary a contract's prose must use; the language door (lang-check) counts every miss
Draft and ready: the validator's two profiles; development starts only from ready-green
Readback: the unit graph and each unit shown to the seats before the contract is final
confirmed_by: the seats that answered for a unit, checked against the ratified intake-seat roster (G0.3)
r4: the REQUEST's intake row, Ready with the contract id and the revision both seats signed
OPEN: a fact the contract cannot keep whole goes back to the REQUEST as a question, never a silent edit
